# Repository Observatory

> Machine-readable entry point for the closed repository improvement loop.

Core rule:
- Observe -> biopsy -> smallest reversible change -> verify -> promote -> re-observe.
- Failed critical checks block promotion.
- Uncertainty causes more observation, not weaker validation.
- The improvement observer is itself part of the repository and may create maintenance/CI load.

## Canonical surfaces

- [Improvement Loop Contract](https://github.com/hopeless-t/chatgpt-recovery-dynamics/blob/main/IMPROVEMENT_LOOP.md): Authority, loop semantics, and imported disciplines.
- [Improvement Event Ledger](https://github.com/hopeless-t/chatgpt-recovery-dynamics/blob/main/data/improvement_events.jsonl): Append-only loop observations.
- [Improvement Event Schema](https://github.com/hopeless-t/chatgpt-recovery-dynamics/blob/main/data/improvement_event_schema.json): RIL event contract.
- [Observatory State](https://hopeless-t.github.io/chatgpt-recovery-dynamics/repository-observatory/state.json): North Star and active frontiers.
- [Observatory Markdown](https://hopeless-t.github.io/chatgpt-recovery-dynamics/repository-observatory/index.md): Human/agent explanation.
- [Repository Audit Script](https://github.com/hopeless-t/chatgpt-recovery-dynamics/blob/main/scripts/audit_repository_state.py): Standard-library invariant audit.

## First cycle

RIL-001 = 3D First Light CI failure -> binary biopsy -> repair -> stale-hash detection -> metadata rebind -> all checks PASS -> merge.
